purpose: Frozen ancillary inputs for ONE-FACTOR assumption comparisons; no live downloads during reproduction.

treasury_1y.convention: Convert semiannual bond-equivalent par yield using 2*log(1+y/2); flat risk-free proxy, not a bootstrapped zero curve.

tsm_dividend.definition: Trailing four gross cash dividends actually PAID by valuation date, per ADS, divided by unmodified valuation spot; constant continuous-yield proxy. No future dividend or FX information.
